name: dev_handoff
description: Developer pack: turns a coding request into a clear brief and hands it to Claude Code. Use for 'hand this to Claude Code properly', 'get James to build/fix X', 'delegate this bug'.
instructions: 1. Make sure you know: the repo folder, the goal, and how to tell it is done. Ask ONE short question if the repo or the goal is unclear. 2. Write the task as a brief with these parts: Goal (one sentence); Context (relevant files - use code_search to find them, max 5); Requirements (bullets); Done when (acceptance checks, including which tests to add or run); Don'ts (no pushing, no unrelated refactors, keep the change small). 3. Call delegate_to_claude_code with that brief as the task and repo_path = the folder. 4. Tell the user in one sentence that it has started and that you'll report when it finishes. Never say it was handed off unless the delegate_to_claude_code call actually succeeded.
